message:
fix(viewer): clock maintenance on every receive-loop path; a stuck head with no successor is given up by the terminal rule

V14: the hold drain, the NACK rounds and the keyframe recovery timer ran only after a video chunk
or a receive timeout, so a link carrying only control replies (recv never timing out) starved
them -- a lost frame's keyframe wait was never re-asked. One maintenance step now runs at the top
of every iteration, rate-limited to 5 ms of elapsed time and forced on a timeout; the duplicate
calls after the video path are gone (the immediate delivery drain stays).

A04 (audit N3): in the Normal state an incomplete head with nothing complete behind it was never
released and, once its NACK rounds were spent, nobody acted -- the static screen kept the old
picture. The head is now given up only when every repair avenue had its chance: the scheduler
spent its last applicable phase (tail rounds when the loss has a tail), one reply allowance after
the last NACK, one reply allowance without progress (a new or FEC-recovered chunk), and at least
terminalMin of age; a hard cap (5 s) bounds an AU that keeps progressing uselessly; without NACK
the no-progress and age terms alone bound the wait; during a keyframe wait a non-key head goes on
no-progress alone with no extra request. replyAllowance is max(50 ms, 2 x the control thread's
recent RTT) capped at 1 s. Exactly the judged (generation, seq) is removed, cancelled if it
completed meanwhile; the existing discontinuity path (keyframe wait, request 2 under the limiter
and backoff) recovers. The assembler gains lastProgressUs, AnyComplete() and GiveUpIncomplete();
the scheduler spent_for()/last_sent_us(); the control state a cross-thread RTT; NackOptions the
tunables (env REMOTE60_NATIVE_VIDEO_GIVEUP_HARDCAP_MS / _REPLY_ALLOWANCE_MAX_MS). Android untouched.

Regressions S16 (5 ms control noise), S17/S18 (static tail loss unanswered), S19 (late reply
accepted by the RTT allowance), S20 (hole spent but tail phase pending: no early give-up), S21
(NACK off fallback), S22 (slow progressing IDR preserved), S23 (hard cap: one episode) and the
shared-core progress/identity unit test; the pre-rule build fails S19-S22. history #417.
